name: Queens of the Stone Age

essentialTracks.title: The Way You Used to Do

lyricQuotes: We get some rules to follow / That and this, these and those
I want something good to die for / To make it beautiful to live

shortBio.en: Homme-led hard rock/alt after Kyuss; Songs for the Deaf is the main radio album; link to Them Crooked Vultures.
shortBio.zh: Kyuss 之后 Homme 领衔的 hard rock/alt；《Songs for the Deaf》是主要电台专辑；通向 Them Crooked Vultures。

body.en:
Queens of the Stone Age formed in California in 1996 after Kyuss ended. Early records and Songs for the Deaf (2002, Dave Grohl on drums) fixed Homme’s tuned-down, repetitive riff writing, Nick Oliveri’s bass era, and Mark Lanegan guest vocals.

Homme later formed Them Crooked Vultures with Grohl and John Paul Jones (2009), carrying related groove and dry production ideas. Emphasis stays on repeating riffs and desert-dry mixes, not shred display. Lineups rotate around Homme.
body.zh:
Queens of the Stone Age 于 1996 年在加州 Kyuss 结束后成立。早期唱片与《Songs for the Deaf》（2002，Dave Grohl 鼓）定型 Homme 降调反复 riff、Nick Oliveri 贝斯时期与 Mark Lanegan 客串人声。

Homme 后来与 Grohl、John Paul Jones 组建 Them Crooked Vultures（2009），延续相关 groove 与干燥制作思路。重点仍是反复 riff 与沙漠干混音，而非速弹展示。阵容围绕 Homme 轮换。

whyMatters.en: Josh Homme’s desert-rock project after Kyuss. From Queens of the Stone Age (1998) through Songs for the Deaf (2002), down-tuned repeating riffs and rotating lineups defined the band; Homme later carried related methods into Them Crooked Vultures.
whyMatters.zh: Josh Homme 在 Kyuss 之后的沙漠摇滚项目。自同名专辑（1998）到《Songs for the Deaf》（2002），降调反复 riff 与轮换阵容定义乐队；Homme 后来把相关写法带入 Them Crooked Vultures。

note.en: From Songs for the Deaf; Grohl on drums; stop-start riff, desert-dry mix.
note.zh: 出自《Songs for the Deaf》；Grohl 打鼓；停走 riff、沙漠干混音。

note.en: Melodic chorus over a repeating verse riff; Homme’s pop sense inside stoner rock.
note.zh: 重复主歌 riff 上的旋律副歌；stoner rock 内的 Homme pop 感。

note.en: From Lullabies to Paralyze; Bo Diddley beat in a 2:40 hard-rock single.
note.zh: 出自《Lullabies to Paralyze》；Bo Diddley 节拍装进 2:40 hard-rock 单曲。

title.en: After Kyuss: desert rock as repeating riffs
title.zh: Kyuss 之后：以反复 riff 写沙漠摇滚

body.en:
Homme formed Gamma Ray, then renamed Queens of the Stone Age after a legal conflict. Debut QOTSA (1998) and Rated R (2000) use C tuning, repeating riffs, and sparse vocal delivery.

Nick Oliveri joins on bass—high harmonies and aggression against Homme’s low register. Mark Lanegan guests on vocals. Desert rock here means groove hypnosis, not jam sprawl.
body.zh:
Homme 组建 Gamma Ray，法律冲突后改名 Queens of the Stone Age。首张同名专辑（1998）与《Rated R》（2000）用 C 调、重复 riff 与稀疏人声。

Nick Oliveri 加入贝斯——高音和声与侵略性对照 Homme 低区。Mark Lanegan 客串人声。此处沙漠摇滚指 groove 催眠，非 jam 膨胀。

title.en: Songs for the Deaf: Grohl on drums
title.zh: Songs for the Deaf：Grohl 打鼓

body.en:
Homme produces and Grohl drums on Songs for the Deaf (2002)—No One Knows and Go with the Flow hit US rock radio.

The mix is dry and mid-forward; riffs repeat with micro-variation rather than long solos. The album title references desert highway radio static as a production idea.
body.zh:
Homme 制作、Grohl 打鼓于《Songs for the Deaf》（2002）——《No One Knows》与《Go with the Flow》打进美国 rock 电台。

混音干、中频前置；riff 反复带微变化，而非长独奏。专辑名指沙漠公路电台静电，作为制作想法。

title.en: Homme network and Them Crooked Vultures
title.zh: Homme 合作网与 Them Crooked Vultures

body.en:
Lullabies to Paralyze (2005) and Era Vulgaris (2007) rotate lineups; Troy Van Leeuwen adds second-guitar texture.

Homme’s producer credits and Grohl’s drum guest spot feed the personnel for Them Crooked Vultures (2009). QOTSA remains Homme’s primary band—riff discipline and dry desert production as constants.
body.zh:
《Lullabies to Paralyze》（2005）与《Era Vulgaris》（2007）轮换阵容；Troy Van Leeuwen 加第二吉他纹理。

Homme 制作人署名与 Grohl 鼓客座通向 Them Crooked Vultures（2009）人事。QOTSA 仍是 Homme 主乐队——riff 纪律与干燥沙漠制作为常量。

body.en: Grohl on drums; stop-start riff and desert-dry mix on Songs for the Deaf.
body.zh: Grohl 打鼓；《Songs for the Deaf》上的停走 riff 与沙漠干混音。

body.en: Melodic chorus over a repeating verse riff—Homme’s pop sense inside stoner rock.
body.zh: 重复主歌 riff 上的旋律副歌——stoner rock 内的 Homme pop 感。
